name: string — npm package name (or package)
in_tree: bool — L1: present in resolved dependency tree
declared_range: string — semver range declared for dependency
semver_admits: bool | null — L2: true / false / null
symbol_reachable: bool | null — L3: true / false / null=UNKNOWN, never guessed
evidence: string[] — human-readable reasons, filled in by whichever gate resolves it
